biotools.summary: DiscoTope-3.0 is a B-cell epitope prediction tool that utilizes inverse folding latent representations and a positive-unlabelled learning strategy to predict epitopes from solved and predicted protein structures. The tool is accessible via a web server and downloadable package and facilitates large-scale prediction across millions of proteins.
